description: The named parts of RimWorld's main loop, for rimworld-perf. Each phase is the first whose pattern matches a method on the stack, walking from the root; * and ? are wildcards over Namespace.Type.Method. Read from RimWorld 1.7.5011's Root_Play.Update and Game.UpdatePlay (November 2026); the interface and loading patterns are not yet checked against a recording of the game.
